newsitem.title: GERMANY: German call money still 3.05 pct despite new cash.
newsitem.headline: German call money still 3.05 pct despite new cash.

text.p: German call money rates remained at 3.05 percent on Wednesday as money remained in demand despite an unexpectedly generous net inflow of 4.2 billion marks at the Bundesbank's weekly repo allocation.

Money dealers said banks evidently expected cash withdrawals to keep rising ahead of Christmas so that banks' deposits at the Bundesbank were unlikely to remain at the expected minimum reserve requirement of about 40 billion marks.
Banks' deposits at the central bank totalled 38.5 billion marks on December 10, before the repo allocation, and the daily average for the month through Tuesday was 39.5 billion marks.
Lombard borrowings on Tuesday totalled about 100 million marks. --Frankfurt Newsroom, +49 69 756525
